value.author: codex
value.text: Functional review found a real defect: src/server.ts never mounted createApp() — legal routes/308 aliases existed only in the tested app factory while the running server kept its own duplicated route stack (catch-all SPA served 200 for every path, /impressum did not redirect). Fixed by rewriting server.ts to consume createApp() and keep only DB init + listen + SSE cleanup. Verified live against throwaway Postgres: /legal-notice serves standalone page, /impressum 308->/legal-notice, healthz + SPA fallback + cookie-consent.js intact. 46/46 tests, changelog:check green, npm audit 0 vulns.
